description: Controls if and what values are saved from zones in an exported results file. See the model results export command. By default, zones values are active . The values being exported by default are stresses , groups and displacements .

description.7.0: Controls if any zone values will be exported.
description.9.0: Control if any zone values will be exported.

description.7.0: applied conditions at zones and zone faces.
description.9.0: Applied conditions at zones and zone faces.

description.7.0: all extra variables at zones and gridpoints
description.9.0: All extra variables at zones and gridpoints.

description.7.0: unbalanced force information at gridpoints, including the last local force ratio.
description.9.0: Unbalanced force information at gridpoints, including the last local force ratio.

description.7.0: Group assignments to zones, faces, and gridpoints
description.9.0: Group assignments to zones, faces, and gridpoints.

description.7.0: Specifies a range used to filter which zones are included in a results file export. This range is saved and restored as part of the model state. Note that this facility is still somewhat experimental, and there may be issues if zone-dependent features like attach, apply, etc. are also included in a results export.
description.9.0: Specify a range used to filter which zones are included in a results file export. This range is saved and restored as part of the model state. Note that this facility is still somewhat experimental, and there may be issues if zone-dependent features like attach, apply, etc. are also included in a results export.

description.7.0: average stresses in each zone. Note that the internal tetra stresses are never exported.
description.9.0: Average stresses in each zone. Note that the internal subzone stresses are never exported.

keywords.name: accelerations
keywords.description: Include accelerations in results output. Present in the engine's keyword enumeration but missing from the crawled docs. Verified against FLAC3D 9.7 (first-token enumeration, 2026-08-13).

verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/flac3d/zone/doc/manual/zone_manual/zone_commands/cmd_zone.results.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
